Class HttpCloudClient

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.continuum.cloud.HttpCloudClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
CloudClient
public final class HttpCloudClient extends Object implements CloudClient
HTTP-backed CloudClient using a service-account Bearer token.

HTTP I/O goes through a pluggable HttpCloudClient.Transport (default: the JDK HttpClient) so the client is trivially testable without a live server. Responses are parsed by their documented (snake_case) field names.
